excerpts: Piles are common, uncomfortable and rarely discussed at the dinner table. This guide explains what piles (haemorrhoids) are, why fibre helps, which high fibre foods work best in an Indian diet, how much fibre and water you need, what to limit, and the warning signs that mean rectal bleeding must be checked by a doctor. Written by clinical gut health nutritionist Meenu Balaji, with the evidence behind each recommendation.

Psyllium husk, or isabgol, is the grandmother’s remedy that happens to have a stack of clinical trials behind it. This guide explains what psyllium is, what the evidence says about constipation, IBS, cholesterol, blood sugar and piles, how to take it safely, which medicines it can interfere with, and when a fibre supplement is the wrong choice. Written by clinical gut health nutritionist Meenu Balaji, with practical Indian ways to use it.

Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is more than a sensitive stomach. It is a long-term inflammatory condition that includes Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis, and it is rising in India. This guide explains what IBD is, the symptoms that should never be ignored, how IBD differs from IBS, how it is treated, and what the evidence says about food, probiotics, stress and exercise, written by clinical gut health nutritionist Meenu Balaji to support, not replace, your…

Cramps, bloating, urgency and nausea: runner's stomach and runner's diarrhea stop millions of runners mid-race. Clinical gut-health and sports-nutrition specialist Meenu Balaji explains why running upsets your stomach (blood flow, bounce, heat, dehydration and nerves), which foods help or hurt, whether low-FODMAP, gluten-free, probiotics or gut training work, how long it lasts and when to see a doctor. Backed by 50 studies, with an Indian pre-run food swap table and FAQs.

Bloating, burping, feeling full too quickly, or low iron and B12 despite a good diet? Low stomach acid (hypochlorhydria) may be one clue, but it is often misunderstood. Clinical gut health nutritionist Meenu Balaji explains the real symptoms, causes like H. pylori, atrophic gastritis and long-term acid-blocking medicines, how doctors test for it, whether apple cider vinegar or betaine HCl help, and when to see a doctor. Includes tables, Indian context and FAQs.

Is saffron good for ADHD? Small trials in Iran and Spain suggest it may work as well as methylphenidate in the short term, or help when added to it. But the studies are small, short and lack placebo groups. Clinical nutritionist Meenu Balaji explains what the research shows for children and adults, how saffron might work, what to look for in a supplement, side effects, who should avoid it, and which nutrition checks matter more first.

L-theanine is the calming amino acid in tea, and millions now take it as a supplement. But what does the research really say? Clinical nutritionist Meenu Balaji explains what L-theanine is, how it may calm the gut-brain axis and vagus nerve, what the evidence says for stress, sleep and ADHD, and how to use it safely. You'll also get dosage tables, side effects, who should avoid it, and straight answers to the most common questions.

Thinking of buying a genetic methylation test? Clinical nutritionist Meenu Balaji explains what MTHFR and COMT results show, what they don't, and why major medical groups advise against routine testing. You'll see what the research says about ADHD, folate, B12 and SAMe, which blood tests are more useful, how folic acid compares with methylfolate, and when a supplement is worth considering.

Semaglutide, tirzepatide and other GLP-1 medications switch off hunger, but they also slow your gut down. Gut health specialist Meenu Balaji explains how GLP-1 drugs work, what is available in India after the 2026 semaglutide patent expiry, why constipation, bloating and nausea happen, which foods help, which symptoms are red flags, and what happens if you stop. Includes tables, an Indian food guide and FAQs.

Scroll social media for five minutes and you'll be told to hum, gargle, splash cold water on your face or buy a gadget to "reset your vagus nerve." Some of it has a grain of science behind it. A lot of it is oversold. I'm Meenu Balaji, M.H.Sc (Food Science & Nutrition), a clinical gut-health and sports-nutrition specialist with 14+ years of experience across India, the UK and New Zealand. This guide explains, in plain language, what the vagus nerve does, what the evidence…

Flushing, hives, bloating, racing heart, brain fog: could it be MCAS? This guide explains what mast cell activation syndrome is, its symptoms and how it differs from histamine intolerance and IBS. Meenu Balaji, an award-winning clinical gut-health specialist with 14+ years across India, the UK and New Zealand, explains how the gut fits in and how food can support your treatment. Includes a symptom table, a food-diary method and FAQs.

Searching 'sports nutritionist near me' gets you a wall of near-identical websites, but almost none tell you who's behind the plan or whether it's ever produced results. Meenu Balaji, M.H.Sc, brings 14+ years across India, UK & New Zealand, peer-reviewer status at the European Journal of Nutrition, and named results: a national U-17 swimming record, an international BJJ silver, and more. Here's what to actually look for in a sports nutritionist for your teen athlete.
